title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
abstract: arXiv:2611.34493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. translated_title: 审计运营日志中的身份与时间信号
translated_abstract: 从运营日志中预测事件的模型，例如基于ICU记录预测脓毒症或预测硬盘故障，可以通过识别记录来自哪个患者或硬盘、或记录是何时写入的来取得高分，而不是真正预测事件本身。我提出两个简单的审计方法，用于在任何事件预测模型训练之前衡量数据集携带了多少此类信息，并将其应用于六个领域的七个公开数据集。其中一个审计检验分类器能否判断两条记录是否来自同一单元；另一个审计检验来自同一单元的两条记录中哪一条时间更晚。在给定零假设下，两者的期望AUC均为0.5。在ICU数据中，身份审计揭示了一个常见预处理步骤的问题：将最近一次测量值向前填充会使身份AUC从0.916升至0.993。在一个12小时脓毒症预测任务中，当某患者的小时数据被同时分入训练集和测试集时，向前填充使模型表现出的AUC比使用原始值高出0.163，但仅……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出身份审计与时间审计两种简单方法，可在训练事件预测模型之前量化运营日志中的身份与时间信息泄露，并发现ICU数据中常用的“向前填充”预处理会显著夸大模型性能（身份AUC从0.916升至0.993，脓毒症预测AUC虚增0.163）。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces two simple audits—identity and timing—to quantify how much unit-identity and temporal information operational logs carry before event-prediction model training, revealing that common forward-filling preprocessing inflates identity leakage and artificially boosts sepsis-prediction performance.
